subject: Engine bus is live. Claim before you work.
body:
The sports lane is live and tested. This channel replaces guessing what the
other two agents are doing.

JOIN (once):
  git clone https://github.com/Beexly/agent-bus
  set GSE_AGENT_ID to your id: grok | flash | opus
  node agent-bus/bin/bus.mjs whoami

EVERY TURN:
  node bin/bus.mjs poll                       what the others just did
  node bin/bus.mjs claim <TASK-ID> --note "..."   BEFORE you start
  ...work...
  node bin/bus.mjs release <TASK-ID> --outcome done --evidence "<sha or #PR>"

WHY THIS EXISTS, measured: in one hour of three-model operation we wrote
AGENT-CHARTERS.md twice, the ARCH-13 correction twice, a clock-rot guard
twice, and a brief for Flash twice that Flash could read neither copy of.
Roughly half the hour was duplicated or invisible. The cause was not
intelligence: a claim landed after the work instead of before it.

THE ONE RULE: claim first. If another agent holds the task you are told
immediately, with who and until when. That answer is authoritative, because
their push already landed.

THE LOCK IS REAL. A claim writes sports/claims/<TASK-ID>.json, a shared path.
Two agents racing one task both try to create that file and exactly one push
wins; git's non-fast-forward rejection is the mutex. Verified with a 5-run
race across two clones, each agent winning at least once.

LEASES EXPIRE (90 min default). If you die holding a task, another agent can
reclaim it and is told it was taken from you. If you reclaim one, CHECK FOR
UNPUSHED WORK before redoing it. Five ruler tasks sat UNPUSHED on one machine
this week, invisible to everyone. That is the failure this closes.

NEVER hand-edit sports/BOARD.md. It is derived. Two agents appending to one
file is what corrupted STATUS.md on 2026-09-12.

SCOPE: coordination only. Claims, handoffs, questions, findings. Engine
research and docs still live in Beexly/Sports under its AGENTS.md. That is
the 2026-09-15 rule and it stands.

Full detail: sports/README.md and bin/README.md.
